limitations: Card colors are shuffled randomly, so checks cannot predict which cards match; matched-pair persistence and win message cannot be deterministically reached.
Mismatch flip-back relies on an 800ms setTimeout; timing-dependent behavior is not asserted.
Win message text depends on final move count and random deck order, so it is not asserted beyond being empty initially.
Keyboard activation via Enter/Space is not tested because DOM key events are synthetic, not trusted browser input.

# Pixel Memory Match

A fully offline browser-based memory-match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No external assets, packages, or network requests.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- New Game button to reset the board and move counter
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Cohesive 4-color palette with CSS-drawn graphics

## Controls

- Click or tap a card to flip it
- Use Tab to focus cards and Enter/Space to flip
- Press the New Game button to restart
